summary: Stream arrivals are recorded in pages, take the graph index under the shard's writer, and an arrival read starts from the first item past its index

replay.detail: No claim, replication or replay changes. stream_arrivals is local to its member, never replicated and outside every digest.

schema.detail: No schema change: the same stream_arrivals table and indexes.

rules.detail: The rules are unchanged. An item's arrival is still the graph index current when this member records it, and its shown time is still its accepted time, or one millisecond past the item recorded before it at the same graph index.

compatibility.detail: Conversation reads, timelines and waits answer the same items. An arrival read (a conversation delta after a graph index) now starts from the first stream item recorded past that index instead of scanning the whole stream.

downtime.detail: No migration. A member with a long backlog of unrecorded stream items now records them 500 per writer transaction instead of all in one.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is safe: the previous release reads and writes the same table.
